# KI-142 — Web: channel list, members, modes and links ports

**Lane:** web · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110, KI-140 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `7672b0e5` (first researched at `5ad41c8b`; see reconciliation.md R-REFRESH)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/composition/local/conversations.ts`, `apps/web/src/composition/local/members.ts`, `apps/web/src/composition/local/links.ts`, and their `*.test.ts` files in the same directory
**Refresh @ `7672b0e5` (2026-10-02):** #976 and #986 merged. `Participant` now has optional `initials` (human) and `ownerInitials` (agent) (`packages/contracts/src/m1/participants.ts:9-12`); leave both absent. Line pointers are refreshed.

## Outcome

In the local web app:
- The channel list shows every local channel with its name, last message preview, sender, time, member avatars (with the Claude/Codex logo) and an unread count. It updates within a second of any change (long-poll).
- The roster shows each agent with its current name and confirmed listening mode, and the owner can switch an agent between steer, sync and async.
- "Invite" / "Add agent" produce a single-use `http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/<token>` link that `khala_join` accepts.

All of this goes through the existing port types. No screen changes.

## Context and evidence

- **D4 / KTD6** (plan): the screens read only `HumanRouteContext`. This ticket fills the following `HumanApplicationPorts` fields (`apps/web/src/composition/human/application.ts:33-59`):
  - `conversations`, `syncStatus`;
  - `describeParticipant`, `describeMatrixUser`;

- web-seam §9 risk 1: `ConversationIndexPort.snapshot`, `listeningMode` and `describeParticipant` are **synchronous**. Before the first load they must return `undefined`, which means loading, never `null`, which means error. Otherwise `room.tsx` shows "Channel access could not be checked" (`apps/web/src/composition/human/room.tsx:141-149`).
- web-seam §9 risk 3: `room.tsx:113-115` hides any channel missing from the index, so the index must list every channel the owner can open.
- web-seam §9 risk 4: listening mode is keyed by `describeParticipant(pid)?.matrixUserId` (`room.tsx:95-99`). Local `Participant`s must set `matrixUserId = userId`.
- Hosted pattern: `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:204-236` (`projectJoinedEncryptedRooms`), `:838-851` (conversations port), `:872-884` (listening modes), `:886-899` (`roomParticipants`).

## Scope

1. `conversations.ts`: `createLocalConversations`, which implements `ConversationIndexPort` and a `SyncStatusPort`, plus the unread bookkeeping.
2. `members.ts`: `createLocalMembers`, which implements `LocalMembersCache` (interface from KI-140's `types.ts`) plus `describeMatrixUser`, `listeningMode`, `subscribeListeningModes`, `setListeningMode` and `roomParticipants`.
3. `links.ts`: `createLocalChannelLinks` and `localAdmission`.
4. Unit tests with a fake `LocalHttp` and fake timers.

## Non-goals

- The `LocalMembersCache` interface itself, `LocalHttp`, the session and the profile: KI-140.
- Projecting timeline events and calling `members.refresh` when a member event arrives: KI-141.
- Wiring these into `HumanApplicationPorts`, and connecting `conversations.viewing` to KI-141's `createLocalChannelService({ onObserve })`: KI-143. KI-143 creates `apps/web/src/composition/local/ports.ts`.
- Showing helper-down or "local" chrome: KI-144.
- Any edit to `room.tsx`, `mount.tsx`, `ConversationList.tsx`, `ChannelSharePanel.tsx` or `features/*`.

## Contract and invariants

Quoted verbatim from `contracts.md` **L13**:

```ts
// apps/web/src/composition/local/members.ts (KI-142)
export interface LocalMembersCache {
  members(roomId: RoomId): readonly LocalMember[] | undefined;      // undefined until the first load
  describe(participantId: string): Participant | undefined;         // Participant from '@khala/contracts/m1/participants' with matrixUserId = userId
  subscribe(roomId: RoomId, listener: () => void): Disposer;        // fires on member/mode changes seen in the room long-poll
  refresh(roomId: RoomId): Promise<void>;
}
// apps/web/src/composition/local/conversations.ts, links.ts (KI-142)
export function createLocalConversations(http: LocalHttp): ConversationIndexPort & { dispose(): void };   // long-poll /api/local/channels; unread from a localStorage last-seen seq
export function createLocalChannelLinks(http: LocalHttp): HumanChannelLinks;   // personal(roomId) → POST /api/local/channels/:roomId/links → {v:1, kind:'personal_link', shareUrl, expiresAt}
export const localAdmission: AdmissionPort;                                    // share/admit → unavailable; inspect → 'unavailable'
// apps/web/src/composition/local/ports.ts (KI-143)
//   no agentJoin, no inviteAgent, no tabHandoff; listeningMode/subscribeListeningModes/setListeningMode from the members cache and POST …/mode
```

The **interface** above is declared in `apps/web/src/composition/local/types.ts` (KI-140, pinned there so KI-141 and this ticket share one definition). `members.ts` imports it and implements it. It may re-export the type, but must not redeclare it.

Consumed from **L5/L6** (verbatim excerpts):

```ts
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/members
export type LocalMember = {
  userId: string;                    // "@khala_owner:local" | "@agent-<8hex>:local"; the web uses it as Participant.matrixUserId
  participantId: string;             // = userId (the web's ParticipantId)
  ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID;    // every member belongs to the one owner
  deviceId: string;                  // agents "KH_LOCAL_<8hex>", the owner LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID; the web's authorDeviceId
  displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex';
  ownerLabel?: string;               // agents: the owner's username (Participant.ownerLabel)
  membership: 'invite' | 'join';
  listeningMode?: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async';   // agents only; DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE when never echoed
};
export type LocalMembersResponse = { members: LocalMember[] };   // present members only
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/events?after=<seq>&wait=<0..25>
export type LocalEventsPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; next: number };   // events with seq > after, ascending, at most 200; next = last seq returned or `after`
// GET    /api/local/channels?since=<revision>&wait=<0..25>    → LocalChannelsPage   newest activity first
//   answers immediately when `since` is absent or differs from the current revision; else holds up to `wait` s
export type LocalChannelsPage = { revision: number; channels: LocalChannelSummary[] };   // revision: helper-wide counter bumped on every append/create/delete (in memory; restarts at 0)
export type LocalChannelSummary = {
  roomId: string; name: string; createdAt: string; lastSeq: number; lastTs: number;
  preview: string | null;                                  // body of the latest m.room.message (m.text), else null
  lastSender?: { userId: string; displayName: string };    // sender of that message
  members: { userId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex' }[];   // present members, owner first
};
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/links                    → { shareLink: string; expiresAt: string }   a fresh single-use join link
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/mode   body {agent, mode, txnId} → { eventId: string }   appends com.khala.listening_mode.v1 {v:1, agent, mode} from the owner (txnId dedup); 404 for a non-agent
```

L3 derived state: "Listening mode of an agent = `content['com.khala.listening_mode']` of its last member event, else `sync`". "The agent writes it (echo after applying an owner command)". So `setListeningMode` returning `'sent'` does not change the cached mode. The roster updates when the echo's member event arrives. KI-141 then calls `refresh` and this cache fires `subscribe`. The roster also re-reads every 5 s through `roomParticipants`.

### Pinned additions (additive to L13; KI-143 consumes these names)

```ts
// conversations.ts
export type LocalConversations = ConversationIndexPort & Readonly<{
  /** Marks `roomId` as open: while held, its unread count is null and its last-seen seq follows lastSeq. */
  viewing(roomId: RoomId): Disposer;
  syncStatus: SyncStatusPort;
  dispose(): void;
}>;
export function createLocalConversations(http: LocalHttp, options?: Readonly<{
  storage?: Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'> | null;              // default: globalThis.localStorage, guarded
  sleep?: (ms: number, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>;
}>): LocalConversations;
export const LAST_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX = 'khala.local.last-seen.v1:';      // + roomId

// members.ts
export type LocalMembers = LocalMembersCache & Readonly<{
  describeMatrixUser(matrixUserId: string): Participant | undefined;
  listeningMode(roomId: RoomId, matrixUserId: string): ListeningMode;
  subscribeListeningModes(roomId: RoomId, listener: () => void): Disposer;
  setListeningMode(roomId: RoomId, matrixUserId: string, mode: ListeningMode, txnId: string): Promise<'sent' | 'failed'>;
  roomParticipants(roomId: RoomId, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<readonly ParticipantView[] | null>;
}>;
export function createLocalMembers(http: LocalHttp, limits: ContentLimits): LocalMembers;
```

### Unread decision (reported to the planner)

No port receives "this channel is open". `ConversationIndexPort` only gets `(ownerId, generation)`, and the list and the open room both call the same `snapshot`. The hook point that exists without a screen edit is the room port's `observe`/`observeEntries`: the timeline controller holds it for exactly as long as the channel is on screen (`apps/web/src/features/timeline/controller.ts:58-62` creation, `dispose` on unmount, `room.tsx:84-87`).
- KI-141's `createLocalChannelService` accepts `onObserve(roomId) → Disposer`.
- KI-143 passes `conversations.viewing`.
- This ticket implements `viewing`.

Rules:
- `lastSeen(roomId)` = `Number(storage.getItem(LAST_SEEN_KEY_PREFIX + roomId))` when it is a non-negative safe integer, else `0`. So a channel never opened in this browser counts every message from others as unread.
- While `viewing(roomId)` is held, `unreadCount = null`, and every list update writes `lastSeen = lastSeq`. So does the moment `viewing` starts.
- Otherwise, when `lastSeq > lastSeen` and a `lastSender` exists and is not the owner, the count is exact. It is read once per `(roomId, lastSeq)` with `GET /api/local/rooms/:roomId/events?after=<lastSeen>&wait=0` (L5, owner cookie), counting `type === 'm.room.message' && sender !== LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`. The count is capped by the 200-event page, so 200+ shows as 200. Until that answer arrives, the previous count, or `null`, is shown.
- In every other case `unreadCount = null`. Hosted shows `null` for zero (`matrix-browser.ts:226`).
- If `onObserve` is not wired, counts still work. They just never clear.

### Invariants

- `snapshot(ownerId, generation)`:
  - `ownerId !== LOCAL_OWNER_ID` → `null`;
  - before the first list answer → `undefined`;
  - when the first list request failed and no list exists yet → `null`;
  - after any success, the last good list, even through later transport errors (only `syncStatus.live` goes false).
  - `generation` is ignored, because it is always 1.
- `snapshot` returns the same array reference until the list or any unread count changes.
- `describe`/`describeMatrixUser` keep entries for members that later left, so old messages keep attribution. They never return a `Participant` with `kind: 'unknown'`.
- `listeningMode` returns the cached mode, else `DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE`. It never fetches.
- `members(roomId)` stays `undefined` until a successful refresh of that room. A failed refresh keeps the previous value and resolves without throwing.
- Concurrent `refresh(roomId)` calls share one request.
- `subscribe(roomId, l)` fires only when the room's member signature changes. The signature is the sorted `userId|displayName|membership|listeningMode` list.
- Share links are not checked against `http.origin`. The helper's canonical origin is `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`, but the page may be open at `http://localhost:<port>` (L11 Host guard allows both), and the `/join/<token>` link must stay `127.0.0.1`. The decoder already enforces http-loopback-only.
- Every long-poll uses `http.get(..., signal, 35_000)` (KI-140's timeout argument) and is aborted by `dispose()`.

### Worked example

List long-poll answer → snapshot item:

```json
GET /api/local/channels?since=41&wait=25
← 200 {"revision":42,"channels":[{"roomId":"!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local","name":"refactor","createdAt":"2025-10-02T09:00:01.000Z",
  "lastSeq":8,"lastTs":1759395700000,"preview":"On it.","lastSender":{"userId":"@agent-b2c3d4e5:local","displayName":"kevin-Codex"},
  "members":[{"userId":"@khala_owner:local","displayName":"kevin","kind":"human"},
             {"userId":"@agent-a1b2c3d4:local","displayName":"kevin-Claude","kind":"agent","harness":"claude"},
             {"userId":"@agent-b2c3d4e5:local","displayName":"kevin-Codex","kind":"agent","harness":"codex"}]}]}
```

With `localStorage['khala.local.last-seen.v1:!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local'] = '5'`, the room not being viewed, and the unread read returning one agent message after seq 5:

```ts
{ id: '!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local', title: 'refactor', preview: 'On it.', timestamp: '2025-10-02T09:01:40.000Z', unreadCount: 1,
  members: [ { id: '@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', kind: 'agent', displayName: 'kevin-Claude', ownerId: 'local-owner', harness: 'claude' },
```

The next request is `GET /api/local/channels?since=42&wait=25`.

Members → describe:

```ts
describe('@agent-b2c3d4e5:local') → { matrixUserId: '@agent-b2c3d4e5:local', participantId: '@agent-b2c3d4e5:local', ownerId: 'local-owner',
  displayName: 'kevin-Codex', kind: 'agent', ownerLabel: 'kevin', harness: 'codex' }
setListeningMode('!c7Kq…:local', '@agent-b2c3d4e5:local', 'steer', 'txn_9f…')
  → POST /api/local/channels/!c7Kq…%3Alocal/mode  x-khala-local: 1  {"agent":"@agent-b2c3d4e5:local","mode":"steer","txnId":"txn_9f…"}  ← 200 {"eventId":"$e5"}  → 'sent'
```

### Steps

1. **`conversations.ts`**
   1. State:
      - `items: readonly ConversationSummary[] | null | undefined = undefined` and `revision: number | null = null`;
      - `live = false` and `listeners = new Set<() => void>()`;
      - `viewers = new Map<RoomId, number>()`;
      - `unread = new Map<string, { lastSeq: number; count: number }>()`;
      - `pendingUnread = new Set<string>()` and `lastSummaries: LocalChannelSummary[] = []`;
      - `abort = new AbortController()` and `started = false`.
   2. `start()`: runs once, on the first `snapshot` or `subscribe`. Calls `void loop()`.
   3. `loop()`, while not aborted:
      - `get(\`${LOCAL_CHANNELS_PATH}?${revision === null ? '' : \`since=${revision}&\`}wait=25\`, decodeLocalChannelsPage, abort.signal, 35_000)`. The first call has no `since`, so it answers at once.
      - ok → `revision = v.revision`, `lastSummaries = v.channels`, `live = true`, `rebuild()`, reset backoff.
      - Otherwise → `live = false`. If `items === undefined`, set `items = null`. Notify, then `await sleep(backoff)` with backoff 1000 → 2000 → 4000 → 8000 → 10000 ms, ignoring abort rejections.
   4. `rebuild()` maps each summary:
      - `id: roomId`, `title: name`, `preview`;
      - `timestamp: preview === null ? null : new Date(lastTs).toISOString()`;
      - `unreadCount: unreadFor(s)`;
      - `members`: `s.members.filter(m => m.userId !== LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID).map(m => ({ id: m.userId, kind: m.kind, displayName: m.displayName, ownerId: LOCAL_OWNER_ID, ...(m.harness ? { harness: m.harness } : {}) }))`;
      - `...(s.lastSender ? { lastSender: { label: s.lastSender.displayName, isViewer: s.lastSender.userId === LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID } } : {})`.

      Then:
      - `items = sortConversations(mapped)`;
      - for each viewed room, write `lastSeen = lastSeq` to storage (try/catch);
      - call each listener (try/catch);
      - for each room that needs a count (rule above) and has no cached `{lastSeq}` match and no request in flight, call `void countUnread(s)`.
   5. `countUnread(s)`:
      - `get(localRoomPath(s.roomId, \`/events?after=${lastSeen}&wait=0\`), decodeLocalEventsPage, abort.signal)`;
      - ok → `unread.set(roomId, { lastSeq: s.lastSeq, count })`, then `rebuild()`;
      - always remove the room from `pendingUnread`.
   6. `unreadFor(s)`:
      - viewed → `null`;
      - `s.lastSeq <= lastSeen(s.roomId)` or no foreign `lastSender` → `null`;
      - otherwise the cached count when `cache.lastSeq === s.lastSeq`, else the stale cached count, else `null`;
      - `0` maps to `null`.
   7. `viewing(roomId)`:
      - increment `viewers`;
      - if a summary exists, write `lastSeen = lastSeq` and `rebuild()`;
      - return a once-only disposer that decrements and rebuilds.
   8. `syncStatus = { live: (ownerId) => ownerId === LOCAL_OWNER_ID && live, subscribe: (ownerId, _g, l) => ownerId === LOCAL_OWNER_ID ? addListener(l) : () => undefined }`. Use the same listener set and notify whenever `live` flips.
   9. `dispose()`: `abort.abort()`, `listeners.clear()`.
   10. Storage access: `options.storage === undefined ? safeLocalStorage() : options.storage`, where `safeLocalStorage` returns `null` if touching `globalThis.localStorage` throws or it is absent. Node 22 vitest has no `localStorage`, so tests pass a `Map`-backed fake. Every get/set is wrapped in try/catch.
2. **`members.ts`**
   1. State:
      - `byRoom = new Map<RoomId, { members: readonly LocalMember[]; signature: string }>()`;
      - `details = new Map<string, Participant>()`;
      - `listeners = new Map<RoomId, Set<() => void>>()`;
      - `inflight = new Map<RoomId, Promise<void>>()`.
   2. `refresh(roomId)`:
      - return the in-flight promise if one exists;
      - else `get(localRoomPath(roomId, '/members'), decodeLocalMembersResponse)`;
      - on ok:
        - for each member, set `details.set(userId, toParticipant(member, ownerLabelFallback))`, where `ownerLabelFallback` is the owner member's `displayName`, or else `'owner'`;
        - compute the signature; if it changed, store it and fire the room's listeners (try/catch each);
        - on the first load, store and fire as well.
      - On error: keep the previous value.
      - Always delete the `inflight` entry. Never reject.
   3. `toParticipant(m)`:
      - human → `{ matrixUserId: m.userId, participantId: m.userId, ownerId: LOCAL_OWNER_ID, displayName: m.displayName, kind: 'human' }`;
      - agent with `harness` → `{ matrixUserId, participantId, ownerId: LOCAL_OWNER_ID, displayName, kind: 'agent', ownerLabel: m.ownerLabel ?? fallback, harness: m.harness }`;
      - agent without `harness` → no entry; skip it.
   4. `members(roomId)` → `byRoom.get(roomId)?.members`. `describe(id)` → `details.get(id)`. `describeMatrixUser` is the same lookup, because `participantId === userId` locally.
   5. `subscribe(roomId, l)`: add to the per-room set and return a remover. `subscribeListeningModes` is the same as `subscribe`.
   6. `listeningMode(roomId, userId)` → `byRoom.get(roomId)?.members.find(m => m.userId === userId)?.listeningMode ?? DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE`.
   7. `setListeningMode(roomId, userId, mode, txnId)`:
      - if `!/^@[^:\s]+:\S+$/.test(userId)` or `!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(txnId)` → `'failed'`, with no request;
      - else `send('POST', localChannelPath(roomId, '/mode'), { agent: userId, mode, txnId }, decodeLocalSendResult)` → ok → `'sent'`, anything else → `'failed'`;
      - wrap in try/catch → `'failed'`.
   8. `roomParticipants(roomId, signal)`:
      - `await refresh(roomId)`; if `signal?.aborted` → `null`;
      - `const list = members(roomId)`; if `undefined` → `null`;
      - map each to `{ participantId: userId, kind, ownerId: LOCAL_OWNER_ID, displayName, deviceIds: [deviceId] }`;
      - decode each with `decodeParticipantView(view, limits)`. Any failure → `null`, matching the hosted all-or-nothing rule at `matrix-browser.ts:896`;
      - return the array.
   9. Decoders (names pinned in the KI-110 ticket; import from `@khala/contracts/m1/local`):
      - `decodeLocalMembersResponse` for members;
      - `decodeLocalSendResult` for the `{eventId}` body of `…/mode` (same shape);
      - `decodeLocalChannelsPage` and `decodeLocalEventsPage` for the conversations port;
      - `decodeLocalShareLink` for links.

      If a landed name differs, use the landed one. If one is missing, write a private strict decoder with `decodeWith`/`object` and report the gap in the PR. Do not edit `packages/contracts`.
3. **`links.ts`**
   1. `createLocalChannelLinks(http)`:
      - `resolve()` → `{ v: 1, kind: 'unavailable' }` with no request. A local channel is joined by agents through `khala_join`, not by a second human.
      - `personal(roomId, signal)`:
        - `send('POST', localChannelPath(roomId, '/links'), {}, decodeLocalShareLink, signal)`. The body is strict `{shareLink, expiresAt}`.
        - ok → `decodePersonalChannelLinkResult({ v: 1, kind: 'personal_link', shareUrl: v.shareLink, expiresAt: v.expiresAt })`. Decoded ok → that value; otherwise `{ v: 1, kind: 'unavailable' }`.
        - error 401 → `{ v:1, kind:'auth_required' }`; 403 → `forbidden`; anything else, including `unavailable` → `{ v:1, kind:'unavailable' }`.
   2. `export const localAdmission: AdmissionPort = { share: async () => unavailable(), inspect: async () => 'unavailable', admit: async () => unavailable() }`. No request is ever made.

## Test scenarios

Use a fake `LocalHttp` that records `(method, path, body, timeoutMs)` and answers from per-path queues. A long-poll answer is a deferred the test resolves. Use `vi.useFakeTimers()` only for backoff. Use an in-memory `storage` fake.

`apps/web/src/composition/local/conversations.test.ts`
1. **Loading versus error.**
   - Before the first answer, `snapshot('local-owner', 1) === undefined`.
   - The first request fails (`{kind:'unavailable'}`) → `snapshot === null`, `syncStatus.live('local-owner', 1) === false`, and the listener is called.
   - After a success → an array.
   - **Mutation check:** return `null` before the first answer. Scenario 1 fails.
2. **Mapping.** The worked example gives exactly the shown item. The owner is excluded from `members`. `harness` is set only when present. `lastSender.isViewer === false`. For a channel with `preview: null` → `timestamp: null`, `lastSender` absent.
3. **Revision long-poll.** The first request is `GET /api/local/channels?wait=25`, with no `since` and a 35 000 ms timeout. After revision 42, the next is `/api/local/channels?since=42&wait=25`.
4. **Errors after data.**
   - A later error keeps the last list (same reference) and sets `live` false.
   - Backoff sleeps 1000, then 2000.
   - A success resets the backoff and `live` is true again.
5. **Unread.**
   - With `lastSeen` 5 and `lastSeq` 8, one `events?after=5&wait=0` request is made, whose page holds 1 owner message, 1 agent message and 1 member event. Then `unreadCount === 1`.
   - A second rebuild with the same `lastSeq` makes no new request.
   - No storage key at all → `after=0`.
6. **Viewing.**
   - `const release = viewing(roomId)` → `unreadCount === null` immediately, and storage holds `'8'` under `khala.local.last-seen.v1:!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local`.
   - A new list answer with `lastSeq` 9 while viewing → storage `'9'`, and no unread request.
   - After `release()`, a list with `lastSeq` 10 from an agent → one request with `after=9`.
7. **Own messages are not unread.** `lastSender.userId === '@khala_owner:local'` with `lastSeq > lastSeen` → `unreadCount === null` and no request.
8. `snapshot('someone-else', 1) === null`. `dispose()` aborts the pending long-poll signal, and no new request follows.

`apps/web/src/composition/local/members.test.ts`

9. `members(roomId) === undefined` before `refresh`. After `refresh`:
   - `members(roomId)` lists both agents;
   - `describe('@agent-b2c3d4e5:local')` equals the worked example;
   - `describeMatrixUser` returns the same object.
10. **Concurrent refresh.** Two `refresh` calls in the same tick make one request.
11. **Subscribe.**
    - A listener fires once on first load.
    - It does **not** fire on an identical second refresh.
    - It fires when a refresh changes `listeningMode` from `sync` to `steer`.
    - `listeningMode(roomId, '@agent-b2c3d4e5:local')` then returns `'steer'`.
    - **Mutation check:** fire on every refresh. The "does not fire" assertion fails.
12. `listeningMode` for an unknown user or room → `'sync'`.
13. **setListeningMode.**
    - Exact POST path `/api/local/channels/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/mode` with body `{agent, mode, txnId}` → `'sent'`.
    - A 404 → `'failed'`.
    - A user id `'not-an-id'` → `'failed'` with no request.
14. **A member who left stays describable.** A refresh that no longer lists an agent keeps `describe(thatAgent)` defined, and `members(roomId)` omits it.
15. **roomParticipants.**
    - Returns `ParticipantView`s with `deviceIds: ['KH_LOCAL_B2C3D4E5']` and `ownerId: 'local-owner'`.
    - It refreshes first: one request per call.
    - It returns `null` when the very first refresh fails, and `null` when the signal was aborted.
16. An agent member without `harness` is listed in `members()` but `describe` returns `undefined`.

`apps/web/src/composition/local/links.test.ts`

17. `personal(roomId)` posts to `/api/local/channels/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/links` with `x-khala-local` (via `http.send`). `200 {shareLink:'http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/AbCdEfGh12345678901234567890123456789012345', expiresAt:'2025-10-02T09:10:00.000Z'}` → `{v:1, kind:'personal_link', shareUrl:<same>, expiresAt:<same>}`.
18. Each of these `shareLink` values → `{v:1, kind:'unavailable'}`: `'http://example.com/join/abc'` (http on a non-loopback host) and `'http://127.0.0.1:47830/open/abc'` (not `/join/`). An `https:` link would pass the decoder, so do not use one here.
19. 401 → `auth_required`. 403 → `forbidden`. 500 and transport failure → `unavailable`.
20. `resolve('http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/x')` → `{v:1, kind:'unavailable'}` with no request. `localAdmission.share/admit` → `{kind:'unavailable', retryable:true}`. `inspect` → `'unavailable'`. No request.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `createLocalConversations`, `createLocalMembers`, `createLocalChannelLinks` and `localAdmission` exist with the L13 names and the pinned additive shapes. `members.ts` implements the `LocalMembersCache` imported from `./types`.
- [ ] Scenarios 1–20 pass, including the mutation checks in 1 and 11.
- [ ] No module calls `fetch` directly. Every request goes through `LocalHttp`.
- [ ] Boundaries, terminology and eslint are green. No edit outside the three files and their tests.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if KI-140's `types.ts` declares `LocalMembersCache` with members other than the four in L13, or if `LocalHttp` lacks the `timeoutMs` argument. Ask before changing either.
- **Stop** if `LocalChannelSummary` or `LocalMember` (KI-110) field names differ from L5/L6.
- PR #976 makes `room.tsx` rename through `context.agentNames` and then call `room.refresh?.()`. The new name reaches the roster on the next `roomParticipants` refresh, because the helper appends a member event and the members route returns it. Nothing to do here. Refresh pointers at pickup.
- PR #978 (per-human colours) reads the viewer's colour from `useProfile()`. If, at pickup, it also reads `Participant.color` for humans, add `color` to the owner `Participant` only if L5 `LocalMember` carries it (it does not at plan time). Otherwise leave it absent; `color` is optional.
- PR #986 adds an optional `initials` to `Participant`. Leave it absent.
- `ChannelSharePanel` caches one link per mount (`apps/web/src/features/channel/ChannelSharePanel.tsx:33-48`). Local links are single use, so a second paste of the same link fails with `link_unavailable` (AE9, intended). Reopening the popover mints a fresh one. Do not change the panel.

## Complexity rationale

2: three adapters over a fixed HTTP surface, each with a direct hosted pattern. The only stateful pieces are one revision long-poll with backoff, a per-room member cache with change detection, and the unread bookkeeping. All are tested with fakes.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
